note: RISK-ONLY CHECK, as of today. Tooling limitation: the web_search backend (searx) returned 'Connection refused' on every attempt, DuckDuckGo HTML/lite endpoints timed out, Google returned HTTP 429, and Bing returned only generic 'Raychem' brand pages (TE Connectivity / Chemelex / Raychem Supply) with no company-specific hits. Therefore sanctions, court, regulator, rating and Russia/CIS-supply items could NOT be verified and are recorded as null — this means 'not found in accessible sources', NOT 'confirmed clean'. Only verified fact: the company's own website (https://www.raychemrpg.com/, fetched) describes Raychem RPG (P) Ltd. as incorporated in 1989, a 50:50 joint venture between TE Connectivity (USA) and RPG Enterprises (India), with plants at Vasai, Chakan and Halol, supplying power cable accessories, surge arresters, transformers and railway/defence products. Risk-relevant inference (unverified, flagged for follow-up): the 50% US parent TE Connectivity is a US-headquartered multinational, which typically implies internal export-control/compliance screening and makes direct supplies to Russia/CIS less likely, but no shipment or customs record was found either way. No sanctions listing, no court case, no regulator action, no credit rating and no Russia/CIS supply evidence was located in any accessible source. Recommended follow-up when search access is restored: OFAC SDN/UN/EU/UK/BIS entity-list screening of 'Raychem RPG Private Limited' and its RPG Enterprises/TE Connectivity parents; eCourts/NCLT/SCI party search; CRISIL/ICRA/CARE rating lookup; Indian trade-data check for Russia/CIS destinations.
